description: This file defines the MultipartStream class implementing the StreamInterface, used for streaming multipart/form-data content in HTTP requests. It handles constructing the multipart payload, managing boundaries, headers, and stream creation for file uploads.

classes.name: MultipartStream
classes.description: A stream implementation for streaming multipart/form-data HTTP payloads, constructed from multiple form elements, with boundary management and headers handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartStream with form elements and optional boundary, creating the combined stream containing the multipart data.

methods.name: getBoundary
methods.description: Returns the boundary string used to separate multipart sections.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable; returns false for multipart streams.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Generates header strings for each multipart element based on its headers, concatenated with boundary delimiters.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates the combined stream from all parts, appending boundaries and individual element streams.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds an individual form element to the main stream, including headers and content, with validation.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates the headers and content stream for a single form element, setting defaults where necessary.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Utility to retrieve a specific header value from headers array by case-insensitive key.
